spec: Blink — face-eyes (slot swap; both eyes per frame as eye-near + eye-far)
Frames: open (exists) → half → closed → half → open. Timing: half 50 ms · closed 70 ms · half 50 ms; random interval 2–6 s; 10 % double blink after 200 ms.
Paint: face-eyes/half and face-eyes/closed (+ happy = closed arcs, later). Each frame fully covers the open-eye footprints with opaque eyelid and skin, so nothing of the open eye shows.
Boxes: eye-near [332, 245, 424, 326], eye-far [461, 256, 535, 334] on the 800×1248 canvas; same lash style, lid crease and warm brown line as v2.
Constraint until hair-front is separated: near-eye frames stay inside the eye-near mask (its top edge follows the fringe), or they would draw over the hair.
Talking — face-mouth (slot swap, no lip-sync)
Frames: neutral (exists) → talking-a (small open) → talking-b (wider open) → … → neutral. ≈ 9 fps (110 ms per frame), a/b in varied order; close via talking-a (80 ms).
Paint: face-mouth/talking-a, face-mouth/talking-b (+ happy open smile, later) inside the mouth box [398, 339, 456, 366], extendable down to y ≈ 372 for the wide frame.
Each frame carries its own skin over the whole neutral footprint (opaque), soft warm lip line, tiny tongue/teeth shading only if the owner wants it.
Idle — breathing, head movement, hair (needs separation that does not exist yet)
Breathing: torso scaleY 1.000 → 1.015 about the feet anchor (≤ 2 %, asset-pipeline §6), 4 s sine loop. Needs torso separated from head and arms (later milestone).
Head movement: head group (head-skin, face-*, hair-front, hair-back) translate y +4 master px (1 u, 1 px @1x) with breathing, 150 ms lag; or rotate ≤ 1° about the head pivot (390, 398).
Requires: hair-front separated from hair-back, a painted hair-back mass, the neck extension (≥ 24 px under the chin) and the face rim repainted with head-skin. None exist today.
Optional hair sway: hair-back ±0.5° about the head pivot, 5–6 s, out of phase with breathing. Needs hair-back painted.
Owner review gate
Every new frame is supplied by image generation (reference-guided from Mom v2) or an illustrator, delivered as files with provenance, and reviewed by the owner before animation integration.
Intake: frames are placed on the 800×1248 canvas (downscale only), checked against the footprints above, and composited over the pilot KRA for a side-by-side with v2.
Facing (native left ¾, kept)
Do not mirror the master. A future rig adapter needs: nativeFacing 'left' in rig JSON; container scaleX +1 to face left, −1 to face right (inverse of the right-facing Boy).
Pivots mirror about the anchor axis (x' = 800 − x on the master; scale with tier). Eyes are named near/far (not left/right) so names survive a flip.
A flipped Mom moves the side part and the baked light; per D15 flip only when she must face right, and review a flipped preview first.
